/bin/zsh -c "node --input-type=commonjs <<'NODE'
const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');let packs=[];for(const base of ['packages','packages-private'])for(const d of fs.readdirSync(base)){const dir="'`${base}/${d}`,f=`${dir}/package.json`;if(fs.existsSync(f))packs.push({dir,...JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f))});}const byDir=new Map(packs.map(p=>[path.resolve(p.dir),p]));for(const p of packs){let edges=[];for(const [name,spec] of Object.entries({...p.dependencies,...p.devDependencies,...p.optionalDependencies,...p.peerDependencies})){const f=path.join(p.dir,'"'node_modules',name);try{const real=fs.realpathSync(f);if(byDir.has(real))edges.push(byDir.get(real).name);else if(spec.startsWith('workspace:'))edges.push('NONWORKSPACE:'+name);}catch(e){if(spec.startsWith('workspace:'))edges.push('MISSING:'+name)}}console.log(p.name,JSON.stringify(edges));}
NODE
